security-content: Your security and data protection are our top priorities
encryption-content: All your personal data is encrypted using industry-standard AES-256 encryption. Your information is protected both in transit and at rest, ensuring that only you have access to your sensitive data.
password-security-content: Your password is hashed using bcrypt, one of the most secure password hashing algorithms available. We never store your password in plain text.
password-li-1: Use a strong password with at least 8 characters
password-li-2: Include uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters
password-li-3: Never share your password with anyone
privacy-controls-content: You have full control over your data. You can view, update, or delete your information at any time. We collect only the data necessary to provide you with our services and never share it with third parties without your consent.
security-practices-li-2: Log out from shared or public devices
security-practices-li-3: Keep your app updated to the latest version
security-practices-li-4: Be cautious of phishing attempts and suspicious links
help-content: We're here to help you get the most out of your experience
faq-q1: How do I change my goal?
faq-a1: Go to your Account page and tap on 'Tap to Change' under 'Your Goal'. Select your new goal from the options and save your changes.
faq-q2: How do I update my weight?
faq-a2: Navigate to your Account page, tap 'Tap to Change' under 'Your Weight', use the number picker to set your current weight, and save.
faq-q3: Can I change my activity level?
faq-a3: Yes! On your Account page, tap 'Tap to Change' under 'Your Level', select your current activity level, and save the changes.
faq-q4: How do I reset my password?
faq-a4: Click on 'Change Password' from your Account page. You'll need to enter your current password and then your new password twice to confirm.
faq-a5: We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Visit our Security page for more details about how we keep your information safe.
faq-q6: How do I delete my account?
faq-a6: To delete your account, please contact our support team at support@example.com. We'll process your request within 24-48 hours.

user-guide-content: Comprehensive documentation covering all features, settings, and best practices for achieving your fitness goals.
video-tutorials-content: Watch step-by-step video guides to help you navigate the app and understand all its capabilities.
still-need-help-content: Our support team is ready to assist you with any questions or issues you may have. Don't hesitate to reach out!
info-we-collect-content: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
info-li-2: Profile data (name, weight, activity level, goals)
how-we-use-content: We use the information we collect to:
use-li-1: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
use-li-3: Send you technical notices and support messages
use-li-4: Monitor and analyze trends and usage
use-li-5: Detect and prevent fraud and abuse
info-sharing-content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
sharing-li-1: With your consent or at your direction
sharing-li-2: With service providers who assist in our operations
sharing-li-4: To protect our rights and prevent fraud
rights-li-1: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
rights-li-3: Delete your account and personal data
rights-li-4: Object to or restrict certain processing activities
rights-li-5: Export your data in a portable format
data-retention-content: We retain your information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services. You may request deletion of your account at any time, and we will delete your data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it for legal purposes.
children-privacy-content: Our services are not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately.
